final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(1.0 * "T-BIL" / CRE) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14' GROUP BY CENTROMEA), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM grouped) SELECT grouped.CENTROMEA, grouped.avg_hgb, grouped.avg_ratio, grouped.avg_ratio / overall.mean_ratio FROM grouped CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL
